name: 血本仙蛊
reference_role: 仅卡框、比例、可信光影材质，非身体和背景

evidence.excerpt: 此蛊浑圆如珠，有鹅蛋大小，珠子上无数氤氲光纹

design_boundary: 除证据摘录所锁外观之外，机位、材质细化、具体比例、自然解剖细节及环境布置为美术推断，不新增原著事实、不沿用游戏id转数。
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW 《问真》 Gu portrait collectible card, exact 5:7. Reference image ONLY supplies fine silver double-line rounded-corner frame with restrained curled corners and physical fantasy realism, not its creature, body, color, background or floor. One fully visible specific subject approximately 55-65% card width; clear subject hierarchy, physical sidelight, realistic textures, restful dreamlike space, complete frame on all sides. No text, title, number, rank, watermark, people, hands, halo, gratuitous gems or decorative symbols. Subject: ONE egg-sized perfectly ROUND PEARL-like Gu. NOT an insect and NOT an egg-shaped oval. The pearl surface bears innumerable soft luminous patterns constantly changing like massed lotus blooms dissolving into rolling clouds. Freeze one instant where cloudy petal-like flowing folds merge organically across sphere's surface, abstract patterns not literal flowers attached outside or lotus objects inside. Smooth dense pearlescent substance with very subtle muted reddish/warm-gray iridescence (colour is design not mandatory canon), volumetric cloudy luminescence confined to skin, spherical solid pearl mass not transparent bubble or blood-filled glass orb. Hovering alone against a muted deep maroon-grey dim softly receding environment inspired by blood-lake context, no gore, people, red ocean landscape or ritual props. Gentle reflected light from below and one soft side light define volume, cloudy flowing surface patterns legible, restrained internal radiance illuminates sphere but no explosive aura. The vivid unusual pattern is this Gu's own identity; not a gold sphere, galaxy ball, ornamental pearl ring or generic crystal.

visible_facts: 单一浑圆珠状体，珠面云卷/莲瓣状流动光纹，悬浮于暗红灰环境
没有实体莲花附着、虫体、符文或伤口，完整银框
risks: 光纹较立体，略像雕花层叠；不将此冻结为实体雕刻材质
暖粉红为美术配色，原著未指定本体固定色
